items.title: 李嘉誠向三院供30個臨床試驗名額 推動組織碎化技術治療腎臟癌
items.summary: 李嘉誠基金會宣布，李嘉誠將向香港中文大學醫院、港怡醫院及養和醫院提供30個臨床試驗名額，令香港成為亞洲首個推行組織碎化技術（Histotripsy）腎臟癌臨床試驗的城市。 基金會表示，過去兩年在香港已順利治療超過400名病人。 港怡醫院和香港中文大學醫院正在以組織碎化技術進行胰臟癌臨床試驗，港怡自今年3月31日開始，已成功完成20宗胰臟腫瘤個案。中大醫院自今年6月3日開始，至今已成功完成6宗。 編輯：黃佩珊
items.titleEn: Li Kar-shing offered 30 clinical trials to three hospitals to promote tissue fragmentation technology to treat kidney cancer
items.summaryEn: The Li Keqiang Foundation has announced that Li Keqian will provide 30 clinical trial names to the Chinese University Hospital, Hong Kong's Hong Kong Hospitals, and the Hong Kong Children's Hospital and Hospital, making Hong Kong the first city in Asia to implement tissue fragmentation technology (Histotripsy) for clinical trials of kidney cancer. According to the Foundation, over 400 patients have been successfully treated in Hong Kong over the past two years. The Hong Kong Hospital and the Hospital of the Chinese University of Hong Kong are conducting clinical trials of pancreatic cancer using organ fragmentation technology, and Hong Kong has successfully completed 20 pancreatic tumours since March 31. Since the start of the project on June 3, the Central High Hospital has successfully completed six projects so far. Editor's Note: This is the last post

items.titleEn: Linlin supports the introduction of government employees with family leave, which would be imitated by the private sector
items.summaryEn: The Office of the Secretary of State recommends that each government employee receive a maximum of 12 hours of "family leave" per year, which is expected to be implemented from January next year. Employees can apply for one to four hours of leave each time, including family visits, attending children's activities, etc. In general, they must provide proof of documents. According to Linlin, vice-chairman of the Legislative Council's Public Service and Financial Staff Committee, supporting the authorities' recommendations to help employers address the needs of families is a key step forward. In addition to engaging married employees in childcare activities, single employees can also take care of elderly parents, especially in emergencies. She believes she can take up to four hours off each time, enough to meet the demand. I'm not sure.
